_comments.description: LINE QA Assistant v2 — RAG + File Search. LINE Webhook → signature verify → session/intent routing → [QA: vector search → Ollama → reply] or [File Search: /search-files → reply] or [File Menu: prompt for keyword]

required_env_vars.PROJECT_ROOT: Absolute path to project root, e.g. D:/n8n/CLAUDE 實做/本地AI企業問答助理
required_env_vars.LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN: From LINE Developers Console → Messaging API → Channel access token
required_env_vars.LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET: From LINE Developers Console → Basic settings → Channel secret

_comments.api_server_setup: REQUIRED: start the local API server before activating: python scripts/api_server.py (default port 8765)
_comments.public_api_url_note: FILE DOWNLOAD LINKS: Update PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL in 'Build File Links Reply' node (qa-node-025) to your Named Tunnel URL once set up, e.g. https://your-api-tunnel.trycloudflare.com
_comments.quick_reply_note: Users send '找檔案' to trigger file search mode, then type keyword. '問問題' returns to normal QA. All replies include Quick Reply buttons.
_comments.credential_setup: Create a PostgreSQL credential in n8n named 'PostgreSQL vectordb': host=localhost, port=65432, db=vectordb, user=testuser, password=testpwd. Credential ID currently: d1sS4zldfDUxHn2j
_comments.schema_note: conversation_sessions requires 'mode TEXT' column: ALTER TABLE conversation_sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mode TEXT DEFAULT NULL
_comments.webhook_url: After import, activate workflow. Webhook URL: https://<your-n8n-domain>/webhook/line-qa — register in LINE Developers Console.
_comments.rawbody_note: Webhook node requires 'Raw Body' option enabled.
_comments.error_handler_note: Error Trigger fires when any node throws.

nodes.name: LINE Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives LINE Webhook POST. responseMode=onReceived returns HTTP 200 immediately. rawBody=true stores raw bytes for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.

nodes.name: Execute: line_verify
nodes.notes: POST to local api_server.py /line-verify. Returns {valid: bool}.

nodes.name: Parse Verify
nodes.notes: Returns null (drops item) if signature is invalid. Passing original webhook data downstream.

nodes.name: Parse Message
nodes.notes: Extracts lineUserId, messageText, replyToken. Returns null for non-text events.

nodes.name: Query Session Early

parameters.query: ={{ `SELECT COALESCE(turns, '[]'::jsonb) AS turns, mode FROM conversation_sessions WHERE line_user_id = '${$json.lineUserId}' UNION ALL SELECT '[]'::jsonb, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_sessions WHERE line_user_id = '${$json.lineUserId}') LIMIT 1` }}

nodes.notes: Reads turns + mode from conversation_sessions early (before intent routing). UNION ALL guarantees exactly 1 row even if user has no session yet.

nodes.name: Intent Router
nodes.notes: Determines intent: 'qa' (RAG), 'file_search_execute' (when mode=waiting_keyword), 'file_search_menu' (when text='找檔案'). Sets keyword for file_search_execute.

nodes.name: Query allowed_users

parameters.query: ={{ `SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM allowed_users WHERE line_user_id = '${$json.lineUserId}') AS authorized` }}

nodes.notes: Always returns 1 row with {authorized: true/false}. Runs for all intents before branching.

nodes.name: Check Auth
nodes.notes: Checks auth. If unauthorized: sends LINE reply and returns null. If authorized: passes intent data through for Switch routing.

nodes.name: Intent Switch
nodes.notes: Routes: 0=qa (RAG), 1=file_search_execute, 2=file_search_menu

nodes.name: Execute: vector_search
nodes.notes: QA branch: POST to /vector-search. Returns {chunks: [...], count: N}. continueOnFail=true for graceful degradation.

nodes.name: Parse Chunks
nodes.notes: Parses vector_search response. References Parse Message for user data.

nodes.name: Combine QA Data
nodes.notes: Combines vector search results + conversation history from early session query. Feeds into prompt_builder.

nodes.name: Execute: prompt_builder
nodes.notes: POST to /prompt-builder. Returns {system, prompt}.

nodes.name: Parse Prompt
nodes.notes: Parses prompt_builder output. References 'Combine QA Data' for user context.

nodes.name: Ollama Chat

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({model: 'qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q4_0', messages: [{role: 'system', content: $json.systemPrompt}, {role: 'user', content: $json.userPrompt}], stream: false}) }}

nodes.notes: POST to Ollama /api/chat. stream=false. Timeout 120s.

nodes.name: Extract Answer
nodes.notes: Extracts answer from Ollama response. References 'Parse Prompt'.

nodes.name: LINE Reply

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({replyToken: $json.replyToken, messages: [{type: 'text', text: $json.answer, quickReply: {items: [{type: 'action', action: {type: 'message', label: '🔍 找檔案', text: '找檔案'}}, {type: 'action', action: {type: 'message', label: '💬 問問題', text: '問問題'}}]}}]}) }}

nodes.notes: POST to LINE Reply API with AI answer + Quick Reply buttons: [🔍 找檔案] [💬 問問題]

nodes.name: Post-Reply Processing
nodes.notes: Prepares updated turns + chunkIdsArray for session/log update. Trims to last 10 turns.

nodes.name: Update conversation_sessions

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversation_sessions (line_user_id, turns, mode)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, NULL)
ON CONFLICT (line_user_id)
DO UPDATE SET turns = EXCLUDED.turns, mode = NULL, updated_at = NOW()

nodes.notes: UPSERT session. Clears mode=NULL after QA reply (resets any lingering file search state).

nodes.name: Insert qa_logs

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO qa_logs (user_id, question, retrieved_chunk_ids, answer)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::uuid[], $4)

nodes.notes: Inserts QA log. continueOnFail=true so log failure doesn't surface as error.

nodes.name: Execute: search_files
nodes.notes: File search execute branch: POST to /search-files with keyword. Returns {results: [{file_name, file_path, download_url}], count}.

nodes.name: Build File Links Reply
nodes.notes: Formats file search results as LINE text message. PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL must be updated to Named Tunnel URL for users to download via LINE.

nodes.name: LINE Reply: File Links

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({replyToken: $json.replyToken, messages: [{type: 'text', text: $json.replyText, quickReply: {items: [{type: 'action', action: {type: 'message', label: '🔍 再找一次', text: '找檔案'}}, {type: 'action', action: {type: 'message', label: '💬 問問題', text: '問問題'}}]}}]}) }}

nodes.notes: Sends file search results to LINE with Quick Reply: [🔍 再找一次] [💬 問問題]

nodes.name: Update Session: Clear Mode

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversation_sessions (line_user_id, turns, mode)
VALUES ($1, '[]'::jsonb, NULL)
ON CONFLICT (line_user_id)
DO UPDATE SET mode = NULL, updated_at = NOW()

nodes.notes: Clears session mode after file search is done. Conversation history preserved.

nodes.name: LINE Reply: Ask Keyword

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({replyToken: $json.replyToken, messages: [{type: 'text', text: '請輸入要搜尋的檔案關鍵字：\n（例如：勞動法、職安、消防）'}]}) }}

nodes.notes: File search menu branch: prompts user to enter keyword. No Quick Reply buttons here — forces text input.

nodes.name: Update Session: Set Mode

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversation_sessions (line_user_id, turns, mode)
VALUES ($1, '[]'::jsonb, 'waiting_keyword')
ON CONFLICT (line_user_id)
DO UPDATE SET mode = 'waiting_keyword', updated_at = NOW()

nodes.notes: Sets session mode='waiting_keyword'. Next message from user will be routed to file_search_execute branch.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when any node throws an unhandled error.

nodes.name: Log Error

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO processing_logs (file_name, step_name, log_level, message, details)
VALUES ('LINE QA', $1, 'error', $2, $3::jsonb)

nodes.notes: Logs workflow errors to processing_logs.
